en: This postcard features a black-and-white aerial photograph of a town with distinct grid-like streets and a mix of lush, tree-filled areas and residential buildings. The bottom left corner of the image contains the text 'Bad Pyrmont Original-Fliegeraufnahme.' The back of the postcard shows printed lines for address and message, a logo for a museum in a castle ('Museum im Schloss Bad Pyrmont'), German-language publisher information, and a serial number (Nr. 19591). There are also some handwritten numbers.
